title: Honey Garlic Sauce
description: A sweet and savoury Asian glaze — sticky, garlicky, and impossible to resist. A family favourite.

method.instruction: In a small bowl, whisk together cornflour and water to form a smooth slurry. Set aside.
Combine honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, and vinegar in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring constantly.
Add the cornflour slurry and continue stirring until the sauce thickens to a glossy glaze, about 1–2 minutes.
Remove from heat and sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Perfect glaze for chicken wings, salmon, or stir-fried vegetables. Brush on during the last few minutes of cooking for a sticky finish.

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week. Reheat gently — the sauce will thicken when cold.
